firstPost.text: Happy Friday — Philly native now in BH looking to meet good people in LA for friends, networking, coffee, workouts, sports, and exploring the city. Into fitness, business, and food. IG: sixfourio

As we turn the page to November, CE will widen our focus to include community service events where we can continue to fellowship while giving back to those less fortunate.
